description: This file implements the driver for the IT8XXX2 eSPI controller, including configuration, interrupt handling, virtual wire management, and support for channels like OOB, flash, and LPC requests within the Zephyr RTOS environment.

methods.name: espi_it8xxx2_configure
methods.description: Configures the eSPI interface with specified maximum frequency and supported channels.

methods.name: espi_it8xxx2_channel_ready
methods.description: Checks if a specific eSPI channel (peripheral, VWire, OOB, flash) is ready.

methods.name: espi_it8xxx2_send_vwire
methods.description: Sends a virtual wire signal with specified level.

methods.name: espi_it8xxx2_receive_vwire
methods.description: Receives the level of a specified virtual wire signal.

methods.name: espi_it8xxx2_manage_callback
methods.description: Registers or unregisters callback functions for eSPI events.

methods.name: espi_it8xxx2_read_lpc_request
methods.description: Reads data from LPC requests such as keyboard, ACPI, or custom opcodes.

methods.name: espi_it8xxx2_write_lpc_request
methods.description: Writes data to LPC requests such as keyboard, ACPI, or custom opcodes.

methods.name: espi_it8xxx2_espi_reset_isr
methods.description: Interrupt service routine for eSPI reset signal, triggers callbacks and resets cache.

methods.name: espi_it8xxx2_enable_pad_ctrl
methods.description: Enables or disables eSPI pad control.

methods.name: espi_it8xxx2_enable_trans_irq
methods.description: Enables or disables the eSPI transaction interrupt.
